params.name: page
params.description: The page number to retrieve, used for paginated responses.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to include per page in the response.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Filter repositories by their specific media type, such as application/x-ndjson, application/csv

params.name: modality
params.description: Filter repositories by modality, indicating the format or approach, like text.

params.name: name
params.description: Search for repositories by their specific name.

items.docs: Fetches a paginated list of all available repositories with optional filters for media type, modality, and name.
Creates a new repository to store datasets with specified properties such as name, media type, and modality.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific repository identified by its unique ID. Includes properties such as name, media type, modality, schema, creation date, and last updated date.
Delete the repository by ID. All datasets in this repository will be immediately soft-deleted and hard-deleted asynchronously, along with all existing downloads. This operation is not reversible.
